title: Review a design from three angles
goal: Find the biggest risks in docs/design.md before we build it.

tasks.title: Failure modes
tasks.prompt: Read docs/design.md. List the ways this design can fail in production, ranked by impact. Quote the lines you rely on.

tasks.title: Missing tests
tasks.prompt: Read docs/design.md and the tests/ folder. List behaviours the design promises that no test covers.

tasks.title: API review
tasks.prompt: Read docs/design.md and src/api/. Point out API choices that will be hard to change later.

tasks.title: Fix plan
tasks.prompt: Using the three reviews above, write a short, ordered plan of design changes. No code.

synthesize.prompt: Merge into one review: top 5 risks, the fix plan, and open questions.
